Hi, Fernanda. OK, the options for the samples. By air, the samples arrive in São Paulo in five days. By sea, it is about five weeks. Air is faster, but it is also more expensive. For twelve small boxes, air costs about two thousand dollars. By sea, it is two hundred. So sea is the cheapest option. But you told me the customer wants to start the trial quickly. In that case, I think air is the best option. If you agree, I can book the flight today, and send you the tracking number tonight.

We are choosing a new packaging supplier, and we have two options. Supplier A is cheaper. Their price is about fifteen percent lower. But last year they were late four times. Supplier B is more expensive, but they are much more reliable: they were never late. The quality is similar. For me, the most important thing is time, because a late box stops the whole line. So Supplier B is the better choice for us, even with the higher cost.
